About The Fish Hub

Fresh seafood supplied with trust, quality and professionalism.

Based in Mount Road, Moratuwa, The Fish Hub is a growing seafood business built on honest service, strong sourcing and a professional approach to trade supply. We work with a reliable supplier who has been in the seafood market for more than 70 years, helping us secure quality products at the right price.

Led by two young, hardworking entrepreneurs, The Fish Hub is focused on giving buyers the best possible balance of freshness, value and reliable service. From daily seafood requirements to bulk trade orders, our goal is to become a trusted supply partner for businesses across the Western Province.
